doc.title: Frank Tate interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clearwater Beach, Florida, March 17, 2001

title: Upcoming Nagel Heyer CD from Belfast 1996
summary: A Belfast 1996 recording with McKenna, Miles, Allen and Alden is coming out.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: Record labels, producers and the business of making albums

blocks.x: Yeah, yeah. I have a CD coming out. We recorded it in Belfast in 1996 with Dave McKenna, Butch Miles, Harry Allen and Howard Alden and it’s coming out in May. After four years the record label gets in touch with me, they’ve got to have the liner notes in three minutes. So I’m scrambling to write this stuff and it’s for Nagel Heyer. Sabina and Hans Nagel Heyer, who are good friends. But once they decided they wanted to move on this thing, they wanted to move on it. So all right, write the liner notes, send them to me, I’ll type them up, send them back to you, you correct them and send back a final copy. And so this was like the airwaves were cluttered for a few days and so it’s on the way out. Harry — well that was four years ago and Harry was just brilliant.
